About

Fashion and commercial model. I work with photographers, brands and agencies on editorial, lookbook and campaign shoots. Calm on set, quick with a brief, easy to direct.

2years in the industry

100+shoots completed

Shoot types

  • Fashion / Editorial

    Magazine and concept shoots, focused on the look and the idea.

  • Commercial

    Advertising for the mass market: clothing, cosmetics, tech, services.

  • Lookbook

    A brand collection shoot that shows every piece and look.

  • E-commerce / Catalog

    Photos of clothing or products for online stores, usually on a neutral background.

  • Campaign / Advertising

    A brand advertising campaign, often more staged and image-driven.

  • Beauty

    Close-ups of the face: cosmetics, skincare, hair, makeup.

  • Lifestyle

    Natural everyday situations: café, gym, street, travel and more.

  • Street style

    Outfits shot on the street, often for fashion content.

  • Test shoot

    A test shoot for the model's and agency's portfolio.

  • Portfolio shoot

    A shoot to create or refresh the portfolio.

  • Social media / Content

    Photo and video made for Instagram, TikTok and other social networks.

  • Runway / Backstage

    Content from shows and behind the scenes.

  • Fitness / Sports

    Sportswear, brands, fitness content.

  • Underwear / Lingerie

    Underwear and related campaigns.

  • Swimwear

    Swimwear and beachwear.

  • Jewelry

    Jewellery, often focused on the hands, neck and face.

  • Hair / Hair campaign

    Hairstyles, haircuts and hair care products.
